name: get_workflow_instructions
description: Discover and load multi-step content-generation workflows (each a bundled SKILL.md that orchestrates the generate_* tools). Call with NO argument to list available workflows and their triggers. Call with a workflow name to load that workflow's full SKILL.md plus the list of files readable via get_workflow_bundle_file. Use before building a narrated animated explainer video, a narrated / personal / philosophical story video, a faceless or AI-narrated video, or an animated explainer.

workflow.description: Workflow name (a folder under the workflows resource root, e.g. 'video-explainer'). Omit to list all available workflows.

mode.description: Whether the response lists workflows or loads one.

version.description: Workflow version from SKILL.md frontmatter, if present.

how_to_load_more.description: How to load detailed resource files.

error.description: Error message if the request could not be served.
